objective: Expose verified Palma information and source results in normal reading without opening disclosures.
protected: CSS, theme, logo and layout rules
source acquisition, robots, per-source limits and provenance
browser-only optional memory and source actions

criteria.assertion: Municipal cards are present in the normal feed with no collapsed ancestor.
Transport operator wording already retained in evidence is readable in the primary card without loss or reinterpretation.
Empty, unavailable, partial and expired source results are distinguishable and visible; no all-clear is inferred.
Unconnected categories remain visible without claiming coverage or inventing data.
Existing event admission qualifiers, city identity, provenance, expiry and source links remain correct; stylesheet hashes unchanged.

evidence.unit: Deterministic presentation cases and existing release gate
evidence.browser: Controlled source-response fixtures plus separate live source observation

layers.trust: Preserve publisher text, source check timestamps, coverage and hashes
layers.action: Existing read-only official-source links; no new account, email or payment action

resources.sandbox: One existing named sandbox; stop when done
